panel.title: Calculated columns
panel.description: Columns worked out from your other columns for every sample, such as GPC. They are never typed and follow the columns they use.
panel.empty: No calculated columns yet. Add one, for example GPC from the thickness and the number of cycles.

form.description: The value is calculated for each sample from its own columns. If a column it needs is not recorded, the result stays empty.
form.unitHint: The unit of the result, for example Å/cycle. The app does not convert units: put the factor in the formula (× 10 for nm to Å).
form.formulaHint: Use [Column name], numbers, + - * / and parentheses. Example: [Thickness] * 10 / [Cycles]
form.previewNoSamples: Add samples to see a preview.
form.previewInvalid: Fix the formula to see a preview.

errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the column.
errors.nameDuplicate: Another column in this experiment already has this name.
errors.formulaSyntax: The formula is not valid near character {position}.
errors.formulaNotANumber: {name} is not a number column, so it cannot be used.

delete.title: Delete {name}?
delete.description: Only the formula is removed. No sample data is lost.

sample.title: Calculated
sample.description: Worked out from this sample's other columns.
